identity.name: Rapid-MLX
identity.one_liner: Apple Silicon local AI engine with OpenAI-compatible API, tool calling, prompt cache, and MLX acceleration.
identity.short_description: Rapid-MLX is an open-source local AI engine for Apple Silicon. It is positioned as a fast OpenAI-compatible replacement with MLX acceleration, tool calling support, prompt caching, reasoning separation, cloud routing, and compatibility with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Aider.

positioning.why_it_matters: Local model serving is becoming a core layer for agent stacks. Rapid-MLX matters because it targets Apple Silicon developers who want fast local inference plus tool-calling behavior that agent clients can use.

seo_article.intro: Rapid-MLX is an open-source local AI engine for Apple Silicon.
seo_article.what_it_is: It provides an OpenAI-compatible local inference layer with MLX acceleration and tool-calling support.
seo_article.why_it_matters: Local agent stacks need model runtimes that can handle tool calls, prompt caching, and compatibility with existing clients.
